_meta.status: draft for the pilot; not validated on real phones; every number labelled Recommendation or Hypothesis in the guides remains so here
_meta.fonts_note: Fonts must be vendored, hashed into the render cache key and licence-checked before use (RD-23). Every licence field is "verify" until a human records the licence; vendored is false and sha256 is null until then. No CDN at render time.

conventions.ref_keys: a {"ref": "common.x"} value points at the common block; additional/overrides extend it

known_conflicts.detail: Message-04 (88-96/112-144/104-128 at 1920) vs planning pack (64-72/84-112/72-88). RD-01 picks message-04; scaled by 0.5625 here. Planning-pack values are a floor for secondary text only.
[V4-MP] -14 LUFS / -1.5 dBFS vs house -16 LUFS / -1 dBTP. House wins. (-1.5 dBFS is a sample-peak figure from [V4-MP], not dBTP; AD-37 corrected 15 Oct 2026.)

[V4-MP] 90 px vs planning-pack 96 px and the safe-zone token file. Larger wins: 96 px, owned by 04_harness_contract/vertical_safe_zones.tokens.json zones.side_margin_min_px (15 Oct 2026; was 90/60/96 across files).

known_conflicts.topic: never frozen vs no decorative change
known_conflicts.detail: [V4-MP] idle on everything vs ROOT/02 E3. Resolved: finite idle only on decorative characters in hook/analogy/recap; off in holds, think, fixture panels, reduced motion.
[V4-MP] 0.5-0.7 s sheets vs ROOT/02 150-300 ms. Resolved by classification: scene-level sheets vs element-level transitions.
[V4-MP] white flash/bloom vs #56. Forbidden; replaced by a localised paper burst.
ROOT/02 and RD-23 use Inter for labels; [N51] says avoid Inter. Resolved: allowed for labels/captions, banned as display.
Message-04 2-4 s vs planning-pack 1-3 s. RD-02 picks 2-4 s.
ExamLeaf teal #087986 is 4.37:1 on cream #f3ecdf (below 4.5). Science labels use #F7F9FC tags.
ROOT/02 has no green; biology green #1F7A3E is a proposed new token pending brand-owner approval.

canvas.rd_ref: Vertical-only decision, 15 Oct 2026 (RD-16 SUPERSEDED; 07_end_to_end_pipeline_instructions/10_DECISIONS_and_CONFLICT_RESOLUTIONS.md) and AD-07

safe_zones.rule: Top, bottom, left and right insets are read ONLY from the source_of_truth file. No inset values are stored here on purpose: exact platform pixel values are not in the verified evidence (report 7.9, 11 item 9). If the file is missing, the brief assembler blocks the brief. While platform_insets_px.measured is false in that file, the insets named by applies_until_measured are used and the job manifest records them as provisional.
safe_zones.horizontal_band_rule: Centre content in the band from max(min_side_margin_px, insets.left) to 1080 - max(min_side_margin_px, insets.right), not in the full frame.
safe_zones.min_side_margin_px_owner: ../04_harness_contract/vertical_safe_zones.tokens.json#zones.side_margin_min_px (single owner since 15 Oct 2026; this value is a mirror and validate_style_tokens.py fails on drift)
safe_zones.min_side_margin_origin: planning-pack safe_margin_px = 96 (04_video_engine/planning_pack_v1/design_tokens.json); larger than the 90 px in [V4-MP].
safe_zones.zone_shares_source: Mirror of zones.top_title.share, zones.middle_visual.share, zones.bottom_caption.share in the source_of_truth file (token_version 1.0.2), which is the single owner. The file wins; validate_style_tokens.py fails on drift. (15 Oct 2026: the old 0.20/0.58/0.22 note is withdrawn.)
safe_zones.title_zone_growth_rule: May grow from 22% to 30% of the usable band for a three-row title, taking space from the visual zone and never from the caption zone.
safe_zones.bleed: Backgrounds, torn strips, vignette, corner sparkles and sheet-transition edges may use the full 1080x1920 frame; everything a learner must read or notice stays inside the safe box.

text_scale_1080.secondary_floor_note: v1 planning-pack ranges scaled; only for secondary non-essential text that passes the phone test (RD-01).
text_scale_1080.basis: Message-04 ranges (88-96 / 112-144 / 104-128 at 1920) x 0.5625; RD-01 and RD-18 (essential labels at least about 50 px on a 1080-wide master).
text_scale_1080.conflict_note: Planning-pack ranges (64-72 / 84-112 / 72-88) are smaller. Resolved by RD-01 (07_end_to_end_pipeline_instructions/10_DECISIONS_and_CONFLICT_RESOLUTIONS.md): message-04 ranges govern essential text; planning-pack ranges are only a floor for secondary text (15 Oct 2026; earlier wording said unresolved).

contrast.display_text_rationale: 72 px at 1080 wide is 24 px on a 360-px phone, the WCAG large-text size (verify the WCAG definition in QA).
contrast.accent_luminance_note: ExamLeaf accents are close in luminance (blue/purple 1.05, teal/green 1.05 computed); never rely on colour alone.

sync.cue_at_window_meaning: cue.at must satisfy word.t0 - 0.05 <= at <= word.t0; the validator rejects at > t0 and warns above 0.10 s early
sync.rule: Every reveal lands on, or about 0.05 s before, the spoken word it illustrates; times come only from the cue sheet (cues[].at, words[]); one sentence = one visual beat.

loudness.note: House target wins over the -14 LUFS / -1.5 dBFS in [V4-MP].
